static_traits.name: Xia Manting
static_traits.social_status: Has supportive friends and family, but not yet sharing specific Self-doubt with them; relationship with sisters strained by pressure and negative thinking
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; never received psychotherapy in the past; no similar psychological problems in the past
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to describe Anxiety and Self-doubt concretely; rather negative and doubtful tone; fair cooperation; able to propose and try self-help strategies (distraction, positive self-talk)

basic_info.main_problem: Since performing poorly on the last nursing-school exam, I have been struggling with inadequacy and Self-doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: Self-doubt triggered by poor exam scores markedly affects my motivation and mental health; seeking support and guidance in counseling.

core_beliefs: I may never become a Nurse

special_situations.event: Receiving and seeing the poor last nursing-school exam score
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If one exam did not go well, it means I am incapable and will never become a Nurse in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Relieving Anxiety through distracting hobbies and positive self-talk
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never become a Nurse

special_situations.event: When studying or thinking about a nursing career
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If doubt and Anxiety appear in Learning, it means I am not suited for nursing
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Shares feelings less with family and friends to avoid making them worry
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not suited for nursing; my ability is insufficient

special_situations.event: Feeling performance affected by Self-doubt in paramedic Work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If Work performance affected, it proves I am not a qualified nursing practitioner
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continues to use positive self-talk to try to encourage oneself, but with limited effect
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot even do my current Work well, let alone become a Nurse

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized as capable and able to become a qualified Nurse
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and being unable to realize the goal of becoming a Nurse, thus losing the future and sense of value
defense_goal: Maintaining surface stability by not revealing specific Self-doubt to family and friends, avoiding worrying them
Reducing Anxiety with distraction and positive self-talk

object_relations.self_representation: An Anxious and unconfident self (worrying about incompetence)
object_relations.object_representation: Supportive family and friends, but Relationship tension from my pressure, making me hesitate to rely on them

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others ask whether real Self-doubt and feelings are shared with family and friends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worries that expressing vulnerability will make family and friends worry or form negative evaluations, so tends to withhold and avoid
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using a gentle, supportive tone; encouraging gradually naming and expressing feelings, normalizing Anxiety; avoiding pressure, offering choices and a sense of pace.

manifestations: Not yet sharing specific Self-doubt with supportive friends and family
Negative thoughts and Anxiety recurring daily when Learning and thinking about Career development

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Not sharing specific Self-doubt with family and friends to avoid worrying them
Over-focusing on one's own inadequacies, daily repeated negative self-evaluation
In counseling, skeptical about change but still willing to try

exception_events.target_problem: When Learning or practicing, the client usually falls into Self-doubt and negative comparison, leading to reduced focus and Decreased drive.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Performed a solo at a school concert and received a lot of positive feedback, and the music professor gave encouragement for their work; at that time the client felt they had done the right thing, and the doubt briefly decreased.
exception_events.reason: Different support: positive on-site feedback and professor encouragement; different context: focusing on personal performance rather than comparing with others; different actions: placing attention on concrete achievements and experiences.

positive_force: Has a supportive network of friends and family
Can proactively try self-help strategies (distraction, positive self-talk)
In specific situations, once received positive feedback and encouragement from others
Willing to accept counseling and try recording achievements to adjust perspective
negative_force: High Fear of failure and Self-doubt
Persistent negative Automatic thoughts (mental filtering, overgeneralization, predicting the future)
Not yet expressing real distress to the support system, causing emotional overload
Studies and work affected, motivation and focus decline
Interpersonal tension,Daily routines and self-care disrupted

target_behavior.behavior: Negative self-talk and Catastrophizing during Learning and Work (e.g. 'I will never become a Nurse')
antecedent: Seeing the poor last nursing exam score
Starting to study or thinking about a nursing career
When Decreased attention or mistakes occur in paramedic Work
target_behavior.core_reason: Fear of 'never becoming a Nurse' and beliefs of self-inadequacy, with cognitive biases of mental filtering and overgeneralization
target_behavior.function: Escaping failure and external evaluation, temporarily lowering expectations to relieve Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Learning Decreased efficiency, Work performance affected, Anxiety and Intensifying self-doubt, Interpersonal tension

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids sharing true feelings and troubles with family and friends
antecedent: Thinking about worrying family and friends
When asked about recent life or mental state
When experiencing strong Anxiety and Self-doubt
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying exposing vulnerability will bring negative outcomes (being worried about, being evaluated), trying to control Anxiety and maintain relationships through withholding
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential discomfort and conflict, maintaining surface stability
target_behavior.consequence: Emotional burden borne alone, support resources hard to utilize, Loneliness and Rising stress
